title: Nrojb's Armorhud
description: This mod displays your armor status on the HUD.
body:
Displays your armor status on the HUD

### Highly customizable through the mod settings

- Change the position of the hud
- Toggle if the armor is displayed vertically or horizontally
- Change the vertical and horizontal anchor position of the hud
- Change the scale of the hud
- Change the spacing between each armor pieces
- Toggle if the hotbar slots are shown
- Toggle if the durability bar is shown
- Switch the durability number between NUMBER_AND_MAX, NUMBER_ONLY, PERCENTAGE, and OFF
- Change the color of the durability number to be BLACK, WHITE, AUTO, and MATCH_DURABILITY_BAR
- Change what you consider low durability (when visibility is set to LOW_DURABILITY armor peices will only show on hud when they are below the threshold)
- Change Armor hud visibility to ALWAYS, LOW_DURABILITY, and NEVER

### Compatibility with curios slots and create backtank
